// diagnostic

E0621

Top-level statements at `{statements}` and {other} are two entries of one program

What

Top-level statements at `{statements}` and {other} are two entries of one program

Why

A program is script style, its entry file's top-level statements, or one `run: fn`, never both, so it starts in one place.

Fix

Keep one entry: move the statements into `run: fn` or the entry file, or remove the `run` entry so the statements run.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0621: Tests/UI/E0927_unknown_marker_constant.stderr.

Error [jet.UnknownAppliedRule]: `#Bogus` isn't a known applied rule
  --> Tests/UI/E0927_unknown_marker_constant.jet:2:2
    |
  2 | #Bogus $limit: 1
    |  ^^^^^
 Why: `Bogus` isn't registered as an applied rule — Jet rules are a closed, registered vocabulary, not any PascalCase word.
 Fix: Check the spelling, or see Docs/Spec/syntax-decisions.md for the full applied-rule list.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0927

Error [jet.ProgramEntryMixed]: Top-level statements at `E0927_unknown_marker_constant.jet:2` and `run: fn` at `E0927_unknown_marker_constant.jet:4` are two entries of one program
  --> Tests/UI/E0927_unknown_marker_constant.jet:2:14
    |
  2 | #Bogus $limit: 1
    |              ^^^
 Why: A program is script style, its entry file's top-level statements, or one `run: fn`, never both, so it starts in one place
 Fix: Move the statements into `run: fn`, or remove `run: fn` so the statements run
